channel.title: Nº 7 Autumn 2017 on My New Hugo Project
channel.description: Recent content in Nº 7 Autumn 2017 on My New Hugo Project

item.title: Editorial
item.description: There is broad consensus on the premise that the global trend towards a higher incidence of damage caused by natural catastrophes observed to date has more to do with the increase in the properties exposed to the risk and their value than to an increase in the hazard level of these catastrophes. Therefore, the guiding theme in the majority of the contributions contained in this issue involves an examination of the many aspects of these concepts of exposure and vulnerability

item.title: The significance of vulnerability and exposure in increased flood risk on the mediterranean coast
item.description: Analysis of the impact of urban growth and institutional vulnerability on the increased flood risk on the Spanish Mediterranean coast.

item.title: The contribution of French insurers to the creation and management of a National Observatory for Natural Hazards (ONRN)
item.description: The National Observatory for Natural Hazards (ONRN) is an example of a public-private partnership that brings together the state, insurers and the reinsurer, founded on concerted governance that embraces territorial groups and partners on voluntary projects to pool data, experience and studies.

item.title: The Sendai Framework for disaster risk reduction 2015-2030. Progress achieved in its implementation
item.description: The Sendai Framework is the structure for concerted international action which aims to reduce disasters in the 2015-2030 period. It was adopted at the third World Conference on Disaster Risk Reduction held over 14-18 March 2015 in the Japanese city of Sendai following a process of consultations, deliberations and inter-governmental negotiations that lasted three years.

item.title: Robotics, artificial intelligence and autonomous vehicles
item.description: In this study we are going to attempt to provide a general overview of the current status in Europe of the so-called fourth industrial revolution, in the field of robotics and artificial intelligence, with particular reference to the so-called autonomous vehicles.

item.title: Amendments introduced by the voluntary jurisdiction act (law 15/2015) and of interest to the insurance industry
item.description: The current Voluntary Jurisdiction Act contains questions of great interest regarding the day-to-day processing of case files by insurers, highlighting amendments regarding the designation of a third adjuster, legal deposits of compensation, settlement hearings, and the declaration of heirs.

item.title: The Copernicus Climate Change Service: perspective from the insurance industry
item.description: An overview of the Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S) and insights from the consultation conducted across the European insurance sector to assess user requirements for climate data and risk modeling.

item.title: Results of studies of the European Commission and the European Environment Agency
item.description: Review of the European Commission’s report on weather and climate-related disaster risk insurance and the European Environment Agency’s report on climate change adaptation and disaster risk reduction.

item.title: Exceptional harm in Law 35/2015 of 22 September reforming the system for the assessment of damages for harm or loss caused to victims in traffic accidents
item.description: Analysis of the Judgment by the Pontevedra Provincial Court of 31 July 2017 regarding the legal framework and boundary of exceptional harm under the revised traffic accident compensation system in Spain.

item.title: Guide to reducing building vulnerability to flooding
item.description: Presentation of the Guide to reducing building vulnerability to flooding, produced under the partnership agreement between the Consorcio de Compensación de Seguros and the Directorate General for Water.
